description: §41.13 strict keys — '{"tag":"Success","rows":42,"extra":true}' carries a key that is neither `tag` nor a payload field of Success: a decode failure, ::InvalidPayload with field `extra`; @result stays .Empty.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md "⭐ RULED — S478 hand-off §3.A and §3.B, PA recs adopted (S479, 2026-11-18)" item 6 (§41.13 strict keys + E-TYPE-080; `parseVariant` accepts an enum alias); ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S478-open-Qs-item-35 (the §61.3 sentence)
rationale: §41.13 Strict keys (allow-list): "The decoded object's keys SHALL be exactly `tag` and payload fields of the variant `tag` names. A key that is neither is a decode failure — `::InvalidPayload`".
